messages:
alex_cs: FYI saw an odd gap in playbook deliveries this morning. some accounts didn't get the scheduled 'first-week-check' but then got 2 copies ~1m later. grabbing samples.

alex_cs: sample ACCT-6104: missed at 09:00, then two notes at 09:01. bodies identical: 'First-week check: any blockers?'

priya_ops: any recent cron or scheduler deploys?

daniel_eng: no deploys. scheduler logs show a missed cron run at 09:00 due to transient DB lock, then a retry loop fired and the job enqueued twice. looks like the job enqueuer doesn't dedupe by scheduled_run_id.

ops-bot: alert: playbook-scheduler v1.4 experienced transient DB lock 2026-01-14T09:00:03Z; retries=3.

priya_ops: short-term: can we add a suppression for rule 'first-week-check' for segment 'trial' for 60m while we collapse duplicates? `POST /ops/playbook/suppress` {"rule":"first-week-check","segments":["trial"],"ttl":"60m"}.

daniel_eng: will patch enqueuer to ignore duplicate scheduled_run_id within 5m window. PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/9120. adding idempotency key.

lena_enable: of the affected accounts, are any in renewal window? want to ensure the 3 accounts with renewal <90d get manual outreach.

alex_cs: counts: 3 <90d, 8 <180d. exporting small CSV to s3://cs-exports/firstweek_dupes_2967012345.csv and tagging high-touch for manual follow-up.

priya_ops: suppression applied, 202 accepted. scheduling cleanup job to merge duplicate notes where body matches and created_at within 120s. tagging deletions with audit='cron-race-2967012345'.

daniel_eng: merged enqueuer fix to staging and added test for scheduled_run_id dedupe. will roll to prod in next deploy window. monitoring for any residual duplicates. :thumbsup:
